title: The Mother Falls for Her Daughter's Boyfriend — Part 8

series.summary: Rentarou bows and begs for Hakari's happiness, and when his eyes meet Hahari's the soulmate shock hits her too — sixteen years of loneliness detonate in front of everyone.

segments.voiceover_text: Back in the present, Rentarou bows until his forehead nearly touches the rug — begging for Hakari's happiness, not his own. Karane plants herself in front of him, blazing, ready to fight the entire mansion. Hahari finally leans forward to really look at the boy who walked through her walls.

Then it happens. Their eyes meet — and the soulmate shock hits Hahari like lightning. Rentarou's destined connection... includes her. Sixteen years of loneliness detonate at once. The ice queen melts into a trembling, blushing, teary mess, right in front of everyone. And this shock does not just free Hakari — it rewrites the entire family.
